name: Psychic Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Magic.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the dispelling touch power of the Magic domain.

Phrenic Disciple (Su)

At 8th level, you gain a small pool of phrenic points equal to your Charisma bonus, as well as one phrenic amplification, as the psychic class feature.

At 12th and 16th level, you can select another phrenic amplification (not a major amplification). You qualify for the Expanded Phrenic Pool feat, but not for the Extra Amplification feat.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st–mindlink, 4th–telepathic bond, 5th–intellect fortress II, 6th–mind thrust VI.
